title: Taking a SEAT: Predicting Value Interpretations from Sentiment, Emotion, Argument, and Topic Annotations
findings: The paper includes 'Be holding religious faith' as one of the 54 values that could be annotated in a text. However, the results are aggregated across all values, and the paper does not report any specific findings or performance metrics related to the prediction of this particular value.
